notes: mission_id present alongside mission_slug: the family's ref field stays mission_slug (REF_FIELD_BY_EVENT_TYPE is unchanged), and mission_id rides in attrs so a consumer can join this moment against a PhaseEntered moment for the same mission aggregate (spec-kitty-events#69). MissionCreatedPayload already declared mission_id, and zeitgeist_attrs has never skipped it, since 8.0.0 first introduced the whole zeitgeist_attrs module; but this fixture also pins the derived summary attr, which no released codec before 8.2.0 reproduces for this payload (_mission_created_summary first shipped in 8.2.0) — this fixture is merely the first to exercise mission_id with a non-null value, added in 9.0.0 as conformance coverage for a capability whose full expected_attrs shape has shipped since 8.2.0 (spec-kitty-events#197).
